connector.name: Obsidian Semantic Search
connector.registryDescription: Read-only semantic search MCP server for Obsidian vaults using local Ollama embeddings.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package obsidian-semantic-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dalecb account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT_ROOT
env.description: Absolute path to the local Obsidian vault.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_SEMANTIC_MCP_HOME
env.description: Directory for the external SQLite index, logs, and cache.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_EMBED_MODEL
env.description: Ollama embedding model name. Defaults to bge-m3.

env.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
env.description: Ollama API base URL. Defaults to http://localhost:11434.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_SEMANTIC_STARTUP_INDEX
env.description: Set to true to run incremental indexing when the server starts.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_SEMANTIC_ALLOW_SENSITIVE
env.description: Set to true to allow include_sensitive tool calls.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_SEMANTIC_EXCLUDE
env.description: Comma- or newline-separated folders to always exclude from indexing, search, and read.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_SEMANTIC_SENSITIVE_PATHS
env.description: Comma- or newline-separated folders treated as sensitive (blocked unless unlocked). Defaults to 08_PersonalInfo/.
